Workout | EMOM x 5
Low Bar – Inverted Bar Row
3 reps – 2 second Pause – Horizontal Pull & Hold
Start with your shoulders pulled back and down – Maintain this position throughout
• Make sure that you are holding your sternum to the bar and elbows behind your back
• Find a distance forward of the bar with your feet that you can hold for ideally 10 seconds
EMOM x 5 Beat Swing – Start Very Small – tension in hollow AND arch!
EMOM x 5 Jump into Hollow – Arch – Press Down –
EMOM x 5 Glute Bridge on Ground – Aggressive Hip Pop
EMOM x 5 Low Bar – Hip Pop to Bar – Power from Hips only – no legs or Arms - stay in your heels
EMOM x 5 – 15 second Hold – Bar Dips – bar at sternum – keep shoulders back and down
EMOM x 5 Low Bar Transitions – bar at sternum – Palms Open
- Stay on your heels – start with hip pop – then Push Down on bar – aggressively find your feet
EMOM x 6 Muscle Up Attempts or Jumping Bar Muscle Ups
OR Weighted Bar Muscle Ups - Dont change your set up to get the weight
Workout | Metcon
EMOM x 10
8/6 AB Cals
1 Bar Muscle Ups
Increase 1 Bar Muscle Up every minute Until Bust then start from 1 again
- Scale to Chest to Bar/ Pull Ups Or Jumping Bar Muscle Ups
Score is Highest Unbroken Round
GHD Russian Twist | 3x10
Handstand Hold | 3x30seconds
siri_text: Thursday's workout. Strength: GHD Russian Twist, 3 by 10. Gymnastics: GHD Sit-ups. Metcon: Handstand Hold. Workout. For hypertrophy, focus on back, hamstrings, glutes.
